tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs sgrub sad bsrung le tshan gyi: gsal byed nor 'dzin drod 'bebs bzhugs so:: swasti/ thugs sgrub rin chen khang bu'i las chog sad srung sprin gyi cho ga dang / nā ga 'brug sgrog gnyis lhan cig tu nyams su len tshul la/ dang po ltar na phyi nang gsang gsum las/ phyi bsrung ba ni/ dpyid/ dbyar/ ston rnams kyi dus/ ri klung las sad rtags shar ba'i tshe/ ri rgya/ klung rgya sogs dge khrims bca'/ sprin chen gyi mdo rgyas bsdus/ klu 'bum/ spang skongs/ sa ri'i bshags sbyangs sogs klags/ rgya brngan lha bsangs sogs kyis yul lha spyi bye brag rnams mchod pas bsrung bar gsungs/ ༈ nang srung la/ ri rtser sprin sdod gnon/ ri thang mtshams su na bun sgrog gzhug zhing 'god pa la drod 'bebs dang gsum las/ dang po ni sprin brgyad sngags dang bcas pa gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin kho bos dpe ris su bris pa dang / sing ldeng gi phur pa khru gang mtho gang sogs ci 'grub/ klu gtor gyi chas dang bcas pa yul gang yin der rlung dang na bun skya 'jigs yong ba'i ri rtse mtho po zhig tu gsar rnying gang rung nas 'byung ba'i yi dam gyi gzhi bsnyen rdzogs pa zhig gis 'khyer la/ nyams len ni gzhung las/ rang nyid lhar gsal klu gtor btang / /bden pa brdar cing 'phrin las bcol/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ dpal sa skya'i gdan sa 'di rang ltar na rdzing bu sogs klu gtor nas 'byung ba'i bcas rnams bshams/ skyabs 'gro nas longs spyod chen po thob gyur cig gi bar a mes zhabs kyi mdzad pa'i klu gtor nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la gang du bshad pa'i sprin gzugs de snod gtsang ma'i khar shar sprin gyi sngags mgo rang la bstan pa bkram/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang nas/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang bar spyi 'gre/ khyad par du yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bka' bden pa dang /

bden pa chen po'i byin brlabs kyis/ klu rgyal bā su ki/ pad+ma/ pad chen/ mtha' yas/ karko ḍa/ rigs ldan/ 'jog po/ dung skyong rnams ngo bo sprin chen sgrog pa sngon po/ 'khrigs pa ser po/ gang ba ser po/ drag po dkar po/ char 'bebs ljang khu/ rmugs pa dkar po/ gtum drag ljang khu rnams kyi gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams na mthun pa'i sprin ji snyed yod pa thams cad yul phyogs 'dis mtshon rgyal khams sad kyi 'jigs pa las skyobs pa'i ched du skad cig thang cig yud tsam la sprin chen brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dang / mdzub mo 'gugs pa'i steng ka bya/ dmigs pa ni gong du bshad pa'i kha dog can gyi sprin rnams kyis thog drangs sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus nas mdun gyi sprin gzugs la thim pas yul phyogs des mtshon rgyal khams kyi nam mkha' sprin gyi kheng pa bsam la dgug gzhug yid ches pa gsum nas brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci 'grub bar du byas la thal mo sbyar te/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bka' dang / klu chen po brgyad kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed dam bca' mdzad pa ltar lnga bdo'i 'gro ba spyi dang / yul phyogs 'dir sems can rnams mu ge'i 'jig pa las skyobs cing / 'bru sogs longs spyod rgya chen po srid zhi'i dge legs dpag tu med pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ bdag gi ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi man ngag las byung ba bzhin/ bca' gzhi/ sngags phyag rgya/ ting 'dzin gyis sprin bsdud kyi las sbyor bgyis pa ltar yul 'dis mtshon sems can thams cad la bde skyid rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phyir sad srung ba'i man ngag ji lta ba bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes bcos min gyi gdung shugs mchi ma phrug pa tsam bdun la sogs pa'i bar brjod la/

sprin gzugs de g.yon g.yas 'og steng rnams nas ltebs/ dar ras kyi skud pa sngon pos bskums la steng phyogs su sgrog lugs bzang po bcos/ de nas gong gi phur pa de nyid mdun du spang sogs ji ltar rigs par zur gcig dang steng 'og rgya mdud kyi lden rang la bstan nas btsugs la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas skad cig dran rdzogs su ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya ba/ sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs su bstan pa/ gsung rngams pa'i nga ro sgrog thugs drag po'i ngar dang ldan pa/ 'gying bag dang rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa gser gyi dril bu sku la brten pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang sbrul gyi gdub bur bcas pa khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum nyi zla 'khyil pa ltar gzigs pa/ tshems gangs ri bltams pa ltar bzhad pa/ ag tshom dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra 'brug ltar du sgrog pa/ za 'og gi ber smug po dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra'i thor gtsug rus pas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis stang stabs bgrad de/ nyi zla pad+ma rak+ṣa srin po ru tra pho mo brdzis pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du brjid pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing / srid gsum zer gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas/ zhes gsungs pas hūm̐ brgya stong khri la sogs pa bzlas la/ de'i mdun du sngar gyi sprin gzugs 'chings thum can btags/ ri rtser dong zlum po khru gang tsam bskos pa'i nang du rdo 'jim pa sogs kyi gdan ji ltar rigs par gong du rang la zhal bstan pa'i phur pa'i mdun lung pa'i mdun dang rgyab lung rgyab la bstan/

gong gi sa steng rnams 'bru sman bsangs sna sogs zhi ba'i rdzas kho nas khengs par bkang la/ sa rdo gtsang mas 'thas par bcag dong kha mi mngon par byas la de'i steng du sa rdo gtsang mas mtho zlum pa rgya ci rigs spang mtho bcu pa sa sngon pos rtsi can grub pa dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ zhes pa nas srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can du zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ gyur pa'i zhabs 'og tu sprin thams cad kyi srog rang dbang med par 'dus nas/ na bun dpag tu med pa thon pas sa la drod chen babs te sad kyi 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes dang / de bzhin du bsgom la gong bzhin/ hūm̐ ci 'grub dang / oṃ nā ga ka la hūm̐/ nā ga le lā+e/ duṃ pa le lā+e/ nā ga ra rtsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba me gha bstus swāhā/ zhes brgya stong la sogs bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya bzla ba sogs klu gtor gyi mjug chog rnams bya'o// ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ rdza'i ga'u so ma'i nang / nas/ 'bras/ gro/ sran ma/ ting dang dar tshon sna lnga/ ba dmar mo sogs las byung ba'i 'o ma/ zho/ mar ste dkar gsum/ ka ra/ bur dkar/ sbrang rtsi ste mngar gsum/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs kyi skabs su 'das mgron la phul tshar ba'i zan hril rnams dang / khyad par 'bru dkar mo rtsa sad kyi skyon med pa bzang zhing rags pa'i phon la/ oṃ nā ga ka la hūm̐ nas swāhā'i bar gong bzhin brgya stong khri la sogs pa bzlas la mchil ma ma 'thor ba phus btab ste gong gi rdza'i ga'u'i nang du bcug kha 'grig par bcad la thum sngon po'i bstums/ ra bon la sgrog rgyab pa'i theg pa gsum dang lhan cig tu gong gi ri zhabs lung pa de'i thang mtshams su dong nas tho bskyed chog dang bzlas pa'i bar gong ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// ༈ /gsum pa ni/ rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa ci rigs par dbyar bsil dgun 'khyag pa'i chu nas byis pa lo bcu gsum bud med dang ma 'brel bas lug gro mo'i drod pa khrag med chu blug la rdza zangs gang rung gi snod gtsang mar blug

sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ chu/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du/ naṃ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las klu rgyal bā su ki sngon po/ pad+ma dmar po/ pad+ma chen po dkar po/ mtha' yas ser po/ karko ṭa dkar po/ rigs ldan ljang khu/ 'jog po dkar po/ dung skyong ljang khu rnams stod lha'i lus can sbrul mgo'i gdengs bdun dang ldan pa/ thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ smad sbrul 'jug 'khyil zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rnams la klu'i rigs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par gyur/ zhes dang / chu shing gi skya ba dmar skyur sogs kyi dri med cing shin tu gtsang bas bzlas pa byed rin mi chad pa dkrugs la/ 'di gong gi sngags brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pas don 'grub par gsungs pas de'i rjes su 'jig rten bde zhing sogs bsngo smon bkra shis ci rigs brjod pa las/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba sogs kyi rnam dbye med de mi dmigs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa'i lugs so/ /nang srung de nyid kyi zhar las 'ong ba'i drod 'bebs 'khor lo ni man ngag ltar ro/ /gsang ba la thabs kyi bsrung ba dang / btsan thabs kyi srung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lung gsum mdo'i bar chu mig gsum nas chu re/ rdo sna re/ sbal pa gcig rnams bzung bar gsungs kyang / sbal pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdzas dang chu'i drod kyis 'chi bas phog thug chung ba'i phyir/ 'jim pa'i sbal pa so ma gcig bcos la rang gi sgrub khang gi steng lta bur gong gi rdo gsum po de sgyed pu byas steng zangs kyi nang chu gsum blug la sbal pa bcug de la mu zi mdung rtse/ ri bong gi ril ma rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba'i phye btab/ shug pa dang khan pa sogs shing sna'i me btang ba la'ang gong gi rdzas btab la chu shing gi skya bas krug cing nam mkha' la 'khar bzhin pas/

skyabs sems ting nge 'dzin gang yang mi dgos par rdzas sngags kho nas sad srung ba'i lugs yin pas sngags ni/ oṃ bhi ta lang teb teb: bha ta ling thib thib: so ba le tib tib: ser 'dus: rlang 'dus: sprin 'dusaḥ swa ta sal: swa ta sal: zhes brgya stong khri la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pas sad srung bar gsungs shing dam tshig ni sbal pa dang chu de la mi 'goms pa'o// ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ drag po'i lugs te byed par spro na gzhung bzhin no/ /de rnams kyi sprin gyi go cha'i dgos don ma lus par bstan zin to/ /yang na 'brug sgrog ltar na/ sngon 'gro dge slong gtsang mas zhag grangs du ma'i bar du sbyang byas la lha klu gzhi bdag mgrin nas bton/ dngos gzhi rab lung pa bcu gsum/ 'bring bdun/ tha ma gsum nas chu blangs/ de rang gi mkhar thog tu nam phyed nas nyi rtse'i bar ci rigs sgrub par bya ba la/ rdza zangs gang rung gi snod longs ma dpyad pa'i nang du chu de blug de la bzang drug klu sman/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ chu shing / gser/ g.yu/ byi ru/ mu tig mu min/ yungs dkar/ bro nas sogs rtsub rigs ma yin pa'i 'bru sna tshogs/ dar sna/ rten byin brlabs can la khrus gsol zhus pa'i chu rnams btab la/ shug pa cha lo can mda' gang pa'i logs la/ yaṃ/ khaṃ/ baṃ/ laṃ/ oṃ/ zhes skor ste bris/ des bkrug cing 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags bzla ba dang mnyam du shug pa spa ma sogs kyi me dang du ba rgyun ma chad par btang la/ ngag tu/ ho mar ra bsdus: snri 'ubs bsdus: sprin bsdus: rak+ṣa bsdus: swāhā: zhes chu ma khol bar du bzlas khol dang / gong gi sngags kyi rjes la/ oṃ a ma hūm̐ thuṃ ril bsdus: pra ti pra ti bha raṃ swāhā/ oṃ nā ga spru lu bha ri sha yā: kris sna ya yā: be ri nag po thib thib: 'bre ya yā+e: sprin bsdus bsdus: zhes nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bzlas la: snga dro chab klu btang ba'i 'o 'chol phyogs thams cad du gtor/

klu 'bum mang du bklags/ phyi dro cha gsum gtor ma ci 'grub bya zhing / mtshan mo nas zung sprin sgrog tu gzhug pa ni/ 'jim gtsang spos dang rin chen bsres pa la: rta gzugs gro dkar byas pa'i khog par/ oṃ nā ga ka khaṃ hūm̐ ya phaṭa ces bris pa bcug de a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sprin rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo rta gro dkar phung khams skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs gzugs su gyur/ zhes dang / rta'i khog tu bcug pa'i sngags de nyid khri la sogs pa bzlas la dar ras gang rung gi skud sgrog nag por btab te/ de'i yan lag bzhi sgrog tu bcug ste khang steng sogs su bzhag go /zhar las 'ongs pa ri rtsar bum gter gyi sgo nas sad srung ba ni/ rdza bum gas chag med pa chus khrig bkang ba la bum rdzas nyer lnga/ man shel dang byi ru rdog re bcug 'jim pas rlung mi 'chor bar kha bkag dar ras dkar po gang rung gi kha bstums la ri rtsar sbas te/ rten 'brel snying po mang du bzlas pas 'bru 'thor zhing smon lam bkra shis ci shes brjod do/ /'di'i rjes rlung gnon drag po'i lugs kyi sad srung gsungs pa rnams kyang byed par spro na gzhung bzhin no/ /de rnams kyi nā ga 'brug sgrog gi dgongs don ma lus par bstan zin to/ /gang ltar yang 'di dag thams cad phyogs gcig tu bya dgos pa ni ma yin te/ man ngag le tshan gnyis kyi dang po ltar na phyi nang gsang gsum las gang rung gcig nyams su blangs/ gnyis pa la yang de rigs 'gre tshang ma nyams su blangs kyang rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba las lhag pa'i skyon gtan nas med do/ /zhes thugs sgrub las tshogs sad srung le tshan gyi gsal byed 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar ba'i dge bas snyigs 'gro mu ge'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
